items.source: This class provides a series of static methods that interact with a thread-local storage of RepositoryMethodContext. The purpose of the class is to provide a convenient way to be used for an application.
items.translation: 该类提供了一系列静态方法，用于与线程本地存储中的RepositoryMethodContext进行交互。该类的目的是为应用程序提供一种便捷的使用方式。

items.translation: 尝试返回当前存储库方法的元数据。

items.source:
Try to return the current repository method metadata. This method is usable only if the calling method has been
invoked via a repository method, and the repository factory has been set to expose metadata. Otherwise, this method
will throw an IllegalStateException.
items.translation: 尝试返回当前存储库方法的元数据。仅当调用方法是通过存储库方法调用的，且存储库工厂已设置为公开元数据时，此方法才可用；否则，此方法将抛出 IllegalStateException 异常。
